body:
Sam (partnerships): Quick sync — coordinating a joint marketplace + vector connector + HW bundle announcement with Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant. Proposed public launch: Wed Apr 14. Need embargo, one-pager, joint blog, HW packaging spec, compatibility matrix, and SDK sample. Who owns what?
Maria Chen: I can own the one-pager and the joint blog draft. Can legal sign off by Apr 7? Also we need Snowflake PM approval for the marketplace listing.
Alex Kim: Eng will cut the connector release branch this week. CI e2e target Mon 4/5. Staging test matrix: Snowflake CSV, Delta Lake flows, Qdrant vectors. Need a small sample dataset + staging creds.
Jordan Patel: I'll loop in Snow PM and Databricks partner lead. Tentatively OK for Apr 14 but request a dry-run one week earlier.
Priya Singh: Product will own the compatibility matrix and release notes. I'll add entries for quantization-friendly models and Dedicated/Private packaging.
Chris O'Leary: HW partner expects to ship images by Apr 10. We need final packaging spec by Apr 2. Also confirm KMS/HSM integration notes for Private deployments.
Sam (partnerships): Action items: @Alex Kim release branch + CI by 4/5; @Maria Chen draft by 4/3; @Priya Singh compat matrix by 4/6; @Chris O'Leary packaging spec by 4/2; Jordan to confirm PMs by EOD. I'll schedule the cross-functional dry-run on 4/9. Sound good?
Alex Kim: Sounds good. Quick local repro for e2e: ```./scripts/e2e_run.sh --env=staging --connector=vector-snow --dataset=sample-1```. Ping me if you need staging creds.
Maria Chen: Draft outline here (WIP): https://docs.redwood/inbox/drafts/marketplace-joint.md :eyes: I'll put the one-pager skeleton and asset checklist.
Priya Singh: Adding initial matrix rows: https://docs.redwood/inbox/compat/matrix.csv — will populate benchmarks and supported model/quant profiles.
Chris O'Leary: HW will provide AMI + docker tags. Labels: `redwood/hw-2026:1.0`. We'll need a small test harness tweak to mount /mnt/nvme for the accel card.
Jordan Patel: Snow PM confirmed embargo Apr 14 10:00 PT, OK with dry-run on Apr 9. Databricks legal is reviewing and should reply tomorrow.
Sam (partnerships): Great — I'll send calendar invites and create the press embargo doc. Also pinging @announce-bot to reserve the Redwood blog slot.
announce-bot: Blog slot reserved for April 14. Reminder set for Apr 12 to finalize assets.
Alex Kim: Minor note: when running e2e against Qdrant, set vector dim to 1536 to match the embeddings we used in upstream tests. Also use `--shard-count=2` for staging.
Maria Chen: +1, will include that in the docs and the one-pager testing notes.
Priya Singh: Can we add a short migration checklist for customers moving from Hosted -> Dedicated/Private? 3 bullets: backup KV cache, rotate keys, test latency profile.
Sam (partnerships): Yes — @Priya please add to the one-pager. Ok team, standups tomorrow to report progress. :rocket:
